title: How A Mantis Shrimp Would Hit You Twice

scenes.notes: Frame 1 is the thumbnail: meral-spread threat pose (real display behaviour), club cocked, YOU tagged.
Two hits 0.4 s apart: the hook plants "twice"; the second ring is warm-tinted (the bubble flash) for the 0:33 payoff.
Hard cut to macro: real shrimp beside a fingertip. "finger" is planted here and paid at 1:12.
The felt number is the boxer; the raw speed is a silent tag.
Same pxPerM for both; the shrimp layer scales 1/17.5 -> 1 so the sizes stay honest.
The hedge sits on the scaling itself (fmZfphacPPQ "somehow" analogue).

scenes.notes: Physical order: latch holds the club, muscles load the spring, latch releases (Patek et al. 2004).
Silent landmark (fmZfphacPPQ grammar): the g-force pair is shown, not said, to keep the spoken number count in band.
Micro re-hook states the strange outcome first.
False reassurance; "usually" keeps it true (cavitation peaks average ~50% of impact, Patek & Caldwell 2005).
The whale never appears before "blue whale" is spoken; it shrinks into the club at "your chin".
Gallows joke 1 (euphemism: knocked out, never said).
Gallows joke 2 pays the boxing frame planted at 0:05 ("pro boxer") ahead of "Tyson".
Self-correcting tone break (PUFFER 0:43 analogue, no profanity).
